# Build routes and service catalogs

These pages are for route authors. They show how to write the routes that CIC serves as MCP tools, and how to package them.

## Pages in this section

- [Write and load routes](routes.md): write `ai-tool:` routes, add dependencies, and load routes from files, Barn, or Git.
- [Serve a service catalog](service-catalogs.md): run CIC from a service catalog in Wanaku Barn, and version the catalogs.
- [Examples](examples.md): working routes and configurations in the repository.

## Next steps

- [Reference](../reference/index.md): look up the command-line options.
- [Deploy and operate](../operate/index.md): run the capability that serves your routes.
